title: clone_copies_memnite replay can hang before Player A reaches a prompt
description: GitHub Actions PR #1141 golden job failed on 2026-03-15 in `tests/test_golden_clone_copies_memnite.py::test_clone_copies_memnite` after `replay` hit its 180 second join timeout. The spectator startup finished normally (`spectator_jvm_startup` was 31.7s), so this is not the observer cold-start timeout issue. The failure path was `AssertionError: Player A script did not produce a prompt`, followed by both cleanup `concede` RPCs timing out. Captured stdout shows Player A and Player B both progressing through multiple `pass_priority`/`choose_action` RPCs before stalling, with the replay phase ending at exactly 180.0s. Evidence: GitHub Actions run `23100059674`, job `67099152103` (`golden`). This looks like a separate replay / bridge ordering bug in the clone scenario, not a spectator startup problem.
